analysis: Re-run only scan 001 organ and vessel labels after a unique manifold contact-pairing fallback; compare the exact source geometry and independent audit with the retained raw and owner-paired candidates.

control.method: Previously retained raw voxel-boundary surfaces from the same source archive, scan, label set, and affine.

method: CPU-only exact occupied-voxel-union triangles. Pair ordinary two-face edges by incidence and four-face contacts by source voxel owner. If a residual edge remains nonmanifold, test the two alternate pairings one edge at a time and accept only a unique globally closed two-manifold solution. Preserve every source triangle coordinate, face order, winding, and occupied voxel.

predictions_before_source_run.geometry: Every output preserves the exact source triangle-coordinate sequence, face count, winding, surface area, and signed voxel-occupancy volume; the independent occupancy-volume error remains at most 1e-9 relative.
predictions_before_source_run.independent_integrity: The independent PLY audit passes source archive, NIfTI identity, affine, voxel counts, serialized coordinates and indices, bounds, topology, and occupancy checks for all 12 labels.
predictions_before_source_run.qualification_boundary: Automatic external segmentation geometry in scan 001 only; this does not establish expert segmentation accuracy, cross-scan registration, Numi subject binding, physical tissue ownership, mechanics, physiology, or clinical anatomy.
predictions_before_source_run.source_identity: All 12 labels reproduce the exact pinned archive, NIfTI hash, affine, voxel counts, and occupied-voxel volumes.
predictions_before_source_run.topology: The v2 owner-paired candidates left one four-face edge each in Liver and Lung. Predict one unique single-edge alternate pairing per residual saddle closes both surfaces while all other label topology remains as in v2. If no unique global manifold solution exists, leave that surface unresolved and fail closed.

purpose: Corrective follow-up to the v2 scan-001 receipt, which retained one one-slice diagonal-contact saddle in Liver and Lung after source-voxel-owner splitting. Resolve only a uniquely determined topology pairing; do not edit labels or geometry.
stopping_and_exclusion_rules: One compiler attempt for scan 001 and labels 1 through 12 under this plan.
An alternate contact pairing is accepted only when exactly one single-edge change yields incidence two at every edge and one cycle at every vertex across the full mesh.
Any zero-solution or multiple-solution contact remains unresolved; do not choose a pairing by visual preference.
Any identity, label-count, coordinate, face-count, area, volume, envelope, serialization, or independent-audit failure remains recorded.
Do not alter voxel labels, smooth, interpolate, decimate, infer expert correctness, or promote these scan-specific surfaces to physical tissue, mechanics, physiology, or clinical anatomy.
